_comment: OPTIONAL. The plugin works with ZERO config for any domain — it infers ground-truth, entities, and terminal actions from the task itself. Only create a goal.config.json if you want to (a) pin exact sweep files for a deterministic grep, or (b) route the adversary to a different VENDOR's model/CLI (a different tier of the same family is automatic for terminal actions, no config). Delete any field you don't need. LOCATION: put this at .claude/goal.config.json in a project, OR at ~/.claude/goal.config.json to apply to EVERY project (e.g. always use the external adversary). Resolution is per-key for the documented keys (adversary.backend, adversary.external_cmd, sweep_files): each is taken from the project file if set there, else from the global file — a project can override one key or add sweep_files without nulling a global adversary. (external_cmd is the one enforced in code by hooks/external-adversary.sh; backend and sweep_files are read by /goalspec per the SKILL. The advanced override fields below are read from whichever file the executor is using and are not part of this documented per-key fallback.)
_advanced_comment: The fields below are ALWAYS inferred from the task by default. Set them only to override that inference with fixed values.
ground_truth_sources: e.g. the test suite / CI, a DB table, an analytics API, an APM dashboard, sensor/lab readings, primary documents
enumerate_entities_step: e.g. list ALL <entities> (not a sample) with real per-entity data before declaring done
no_harm_threshold: e.g. don't remove/scale what works without a validated replacement and a reversible path
